title: Phagocytosis Study of Apoptotic Murine Splenocytes by Antigen-Presenting Cells In Vitro
author: Braun, Zeiser
materials:
Timing: 1 h
1.Prepare cRPMI, staining buffer and buffers for PrimeFlow before use.2.cRPMI and flow cytometry staining buffer can be stored at 4°C. Buffers for PrimeFlow should be prepared directly before use.3.Recombinant murine M-CSF and recombinant murine GM-CSF are bought as lyophilized stock and should be prepared according to manufacturer’s instructions. The LOT-specific instructions for cytokine reconstitutions can be downloaded after the purchase of the product.a.Cytokine stocks can be stored at −20°C.b.Cytokines should always be added freshly to the culture medium.

steps.title: Prepare media and buffers
steps.instruction: Make cRPMI, flow‑cytometry staining buffer and all PrimeFlow buffers; store cRPMI and staining buffer at 4 °C, prepare PrimeFlow buffers immediately before use; reconstitute lyophilized murine M‑CSF and GM‑CSF according to the manufacturer, keep cytokine stocks at –20 °C and add freshly to culture medium.

substeps.instruction: Prepare complete RPMI (cRPMI) and a staining buffer (PBS + 2 % FBS or as described).
Aliquot and store cRPMI and staining buffer at 4 °C.

Prepare PrimeFlow buffers (Fixation, Permeabilization, Wash, RNA Fixation, RNA Permeabilization, RNA Wash, RNA Storage, PreAmp Mix, Amp Mix, Label Probe Diluent) directly before use; keep on ice or at room temperature as indicated.
Reconstitute recombinant murine M‑CSF and GM‑CSF lyophilized stocks in sterile water according to the lot‑specific instructions; store reconstituted stocks at –20 °C.
Add cytokines freshly to cRPMI immediately before use.

steps.title: Isolate bone marrow cells
steps.instruction: Harvest femur and tibia from euthanized CD45.2 mice, flush marrow, filter, lyse erythrocytes, and resuspend in cRPMI for counting.

substeps.instruction: Euthanize CD45.2 C57BL/6N mice (7–10 weeks) according to institutional guidelines and disinfect with 70 % ethanol.
Dissect femur and tibia, remove muscle and connective tissue, place bones in cold 1 × PBS.
Under a laminar‑flow hood, flush bone marrow into 1 × PBS using a 25‑G needle and syringe.
Filter the cell suspension through a 70 µm cell strainer into a 50 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge 300 × g for 10 min at 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 2 mL ACK lysis buffer, incubate 2 min at room temperature (20–25 °C).
Add 40 mL 1 × PBS, mix, then centrifuge 300 × g for 10 min at 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 30 mL cRPMI, count, and keep on ice.

steps.title: ECP treat and CTV stain splenocytes
steps.instruction: Isolate splenocytes from CD45.1 mice, lyse erythrocytes, treat with 8‑methoxypsoralen (200 ng/mL) and 2.0 J/cm² UVA, wash, then stain with 1 µM CellTrace Violet, quench, wash, count and adjust to 2 × 10⁶ cells/mL.

substeps.instruction: Euthanize CD45.1 C57BL/6N mice (7–10 weeks) by cervical dislocation or approved method.
Harvest spleen, mash through a 100 µm strainer into a 6 cm dish containing 5 mL PBS.
Centrifuge 300 × g for 5 min at 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 2 mL ACK lysis buffer, incubate 2 min at room temperature, add 40 mL PBS, centrifuge 300 × g for 5 min at 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Resuspend splenocytes in cRPMI at 5 × 10⁶ cells/mL and plate 12 mL per 10 cm dish.
Add 8‑methoxypsoralen (UVADEX) to a final concentration of 200 ng/mL; incubate 30 min at 37 °C in the dark.
Expose cells to UVA at 2.0 J/cm² using a BS‑02 UVA chamber (Opsytec) in dose‑controlled mode.
Wash cells twice with 1 × PBS, discard supernatant, and resuspend in pre‑warmed PBS (37 °C) to 1 × 10⁶ cells/mL in a 50 mL tube.
Prepare CTV stock: dissolve one vial of CellTrace Violet in 20 µL DMSO (5 mM).
Dilute CTV stock 1:5 in 1 × PBS (final 1 µM).
Add CTV to the cell suspension (final 1 µM), vortex briefly, and incubate 20 min at 37 °C.
Quench staining by adding double volume of cRPMI (containing ≥10 % serum), centrifuge 300 × g for 5 min at 20–25 °C, discard supernatant.
Wash cells twice with 30 mL cRPMI, centrifuge 300 × g for 5 min at 20–25 °C each wash.
Resuspend in cRPMI, count, and adjust to 2 × 10⁶ cells/mL in cRPMI.
Note: retain an untreated splenocyte aliquot as a death‑control; calreticulin analysis can be performed on non‑CTV‑stained cells.

steps.title: Assess calreticulin surface expression
steps.instruction: Stain ECP‑treated splenocytes (24 h post‑treatment) for viability, block Fc receptors, stain with anti‑calreticulin (1:200) and anti‑rabbit PE (1:50), then keep on ice until acquisition.

substeps.instruction: Transfer cells to a FACS tube, add 2 mL 1 × PBS, centrifuge 300 × g for 5 min at 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Wash once with 4 mL 1 × PBS, discard supernatant.
Resuspend in 100 µL viability stain (Zombie NIR Fixable Viability Kit diluted 1:500 in PBS), incubate 15 min at 4 °C.
Wash twice with flow‑cytometry staining buffer (300 × g, 5 min, 4 °C).
Resuspend in 50 µL anti‑CD16/32 (1:25 in staining buffer), incubate 10 min at 4 °C.
Add 50 µL anti‑calreticulin (1:100 in staining buffer; final 1:200), incubate 20 min at 4 °C.
Wash twice (300 × g, 5 min, 4 °C).
Resuspend in 100 µL secondary anti‑rabbit PE (1:50 in staining buffer), incubate 20 min at 4 °C.
Wash twice (300 × g, 5 min, 4 °C) and resuspend in staining buffer; keep at 4 °C until flow acquisition.

steps.title: FACS phagocytosis & BMDM polarization
steps.instruction: Collect co‑culture cells, stain BMDCs and BMDMs separately for viability, Fc block, congenic markers and polarization markers, fix/permeabilize BMDMs for intracellular Arg‑1 staining.

substeps.instruction: BMDC analysis:
a. Harvest supernatant and scrape adherent cells from the co‑culture plate; transfer all cells to a 50 mL tube.
b. Add 1 × PBS to 40 mL, centrifuge 300 × g for 5 min at 4 °C; discard supernatant.
c. Resuspend pellet in 100 µL viability stain (Zombie NIR 1:500 in PBS), incubate 15 min at 4 °C.
d. Wash twice with staining buffer (500 × g, 3 min, 4 °C).
e. Block Fc receptors with 50 µL anti‑CD16/32 (1:25 in buffer), incubate 10 min at 4 °C.
f. Add 50 µL surface antibody mix (anti‑CD45.1 FITC and anti‑CD45.2 BV711, each 1:50; final 1:100), incubate 30 min at 4 °C.
g. Wash twice (500 × g, 3 min, 4 °C) and resuspend in 200 µL staining buffer; keep at 4 °C in the dark until acquisition.
BMDM analysis:
a. Discard supernatant, wash adherent BMDM layer once with PBS (optional: collect supernatant cells).
b. Scrape BMDMs with a cell scraper, transfer to a 50 mL tube, add 40 mL 1 × PBS, centrifuge 300 × g for 5 min at 4 °C; discard supernatant.
c. Distribute cells into a 96‑well round‑bottom plate.
d. Spin 500 × g for 3 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant.
e. Viability stain: 100 µL Zombie NIR (1:500 in PBS), incubate 15 min at 4 °C.
f. Wash twice with staining buffer (500 × g, 3 min, 4 °C).
g. Block Fc receptors with 50 µL anti‑CD16/32 (1:25), incubate 10 min at 4 °C.
h. Surface stain with 50 µL antibody mix (anti‑CD45.1 FITC, anti‑CD45.2 BV711, anti‑CD206 PE, anti‑CD301 PE‑Cy7; each 1:50; final 1:100), incubate 30 min at 4 °C.
i. Wash twice (500 × g, 3 min, 4 °C).
j. Fix/perm: resuspend in 200 µL BD Cytofix/Cytoperm, incubate 40 min at 4 °C.
k. Spin 750 × g for 3 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant.
l. Wash twice with 200 µL 1 × BD Perm/Wash Buffer (750 × g, 3 min, 4 °C).
m. Intracellular Arg‑1 stain: resuspend in 100 µL anti‑Arginase 1 APC (1:100 in Perm/Wash), incubate 30 min at 4 °C.
n. Wash twice with 200 µL Perm/Wash Buffer (750 × g, 3 min, 4 °C).
o. Resuspend in 150 µL Perm/Wash Buffer, keep at 4 °C in the dark until acquisition.

steps.title: FACS STAT6 phosphorylation
steps.instruction: Stain BMDMs for viability, Fc block, CD45.2, fix/permeabilize, then stain intracellular phospho‑STAT6 (Y641) with AlexaFluor 488 (1:5).

substeps.instruction: Discard supernatant, wash BMDM layer once with PBS.
Scrape adherent BMDMs, transfer to a 50 mL tube, add 40 mL 1 × PBS, centrifuge 300 × g for 5 min at 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Distribute cells into a 96‑well round‑bottom plate.
Spin 500 × g for 3 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant.
Viability stain: 100 µL Zombie NIR (1:500 in PBS), incubate 10 min at 4 °C.
Wash twice with staining buffer (500 × g, 3 min, 4 °C).
Block Fc receptors with 50 µL anti‑CD16/32 (1:25), incubate 5 min at 4 °C.
Add 50 µL surface antibody (anti‑CD45.2 PE, 1:50; final 1:100), incubate 15 min at 4 °C.
Wash twice (500 × g, 3 min, 4 °C).
Fix/lyse: resuspend in 200 µL pre‑warmed 1 × Lyse/Fix Buffer, incubate 10 min at 37 °C.
Spin 500 × g for 3 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, wash once with staining buffer.
Permeabilize: resuspend in 200 µL ice‑cold Perm Buffer III, incubate 30 min at 4 °C.
Spin 500 × g for 3 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant.
Wash twice with BD Stain Buffer (500 × g, 3 min, 4 °C).
Add 100 µL anti‑pSTAT6 (Y641) AlexaFluor 488 (1:5 in BD Stain Buffer), incubate 30 min at 4 °C.
Wash twice with BD Stain Buffer (500 × g, 3 min, 4 °C).
Resuspend in 150 µL BD Stain Buffer, keep at 4 °C in the dark until acquisition.

steps.title: PrimeFlow Adipoq expression
steps.instruction: Stain BMDMs for viability, Fc block, CD45.2, then perform the full PrimeFlow RNA workflow to detect Adipoq transcripts, ending with storage at 4 °C until acquisition.

substeps.instruction: Discard supernatant, wash BMDM layer once with PBS.
Scrape BMDMs, transfer to a 50 mL tube, add 40 mL 1 × PBS, centrifuge 300 × g for 5 min at 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Distribute cells into a 96‑well round‑bottom plate.
Spin 500 × g for 3 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant.
Viability stain: 100 µL Zombie NIR (1:500 in PBS), incubate 10 min at 4 °C.
Wash twice with staining buffer (500 × g, 3 min, 4 °C).
Block Fc receptors with 50 µL anti‑CD16/32 (1:25), incubate 5 min at 4 °C.
Surface stain: 50 µL anti‑CD45.2 PE (1:50; final 1:100), incubate 15 min at 4 °C.
Transfer cells to 1.5 mL tubes supplied with the PrimeFlow Kit; add 1 mL staining buffer, spin 800 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant; repeat wash once.
Fixation 1: add 1 mL PrimeFlow RNA Fixation Buffer 1, invert, incubate 30 min at 4 °C, spin 800 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, resuspend in residual volume.
Permeabilization: add 1 mL PrimeFlow RNA Permeabilization Buffer with RNase inhibitor, spin 800 × g for 5 min at 4 °C; repeat total of three washes with this buffer.

Fixation 2: add 1 mL PrimeFlow RNA Fixation Buffer 2, invert, incubate 60 min at 20–25 °C (RT) in the dark (do NOT place on ice), spin 800 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, aspirate all but 100 µL, vortex to resuspend.
Wash 1: add 1 mL PrimeFlow RNA Wash Buffer, invert, spin 800 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, aspirate to 100 µL, vortex.
Wash 2: repeat Wash 1 (total of two washes, cells remain in 100 µL).

Target probe hybridization: pre‑warm Target Probe Diluent to 40 °C, dilute Adipoq target probe 1:20 in diluent, add 100 µL diluted probe to each sample, vortex, incubate 2 h at 40 °C (vortex 3 s after 1 h).
Wash 3: add 1 mL RNA Wash Buffer, invert, spin 800 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, aspirate to 100 µL, vortex.
Wash 4 (with RNase inhibitor): add 1 mL RNA Wash Buffer with RNase inhibitor, spin 800 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, aspirate to 100 µL, vortex.
Store samples at 4 °C (≤16 h) – optional pause point.
Pre‑amplification: pre‑warm PreAmp Mix to 40 °C, add 100 µL to each tube, vortex, incubate 90 min at 40 °C.
Wash 5: add 1 mL RNA Wash Buffer, invert, spin 800 × g for 5 min at RT, aspirate to 100 µL; repeat for a total of three washes.
Amplification: add 100 µL PrimeFlow RNA Amp Mix, vortex, incubate 90 min at 40 °C.
Wash 6: add 1 mL RNA Wash Buffer, invert, spin 800 × g for 5 min at RT, aspirate to 100 µL; repeat for two washes (cells remain in 100 µL).
Label probe hybridization: dilute RNA label probes 1:100 in PrimeFlow Label Probe Diluent, add 100 µL to each sample, vortex, incubate 60 min at 40 °C.
Wash 7: add 1 mL RNA Wash Buffer, invert, spin 800 × g for 5 min at RT, aspirate to 100 µL; repeat for two washes.
Final storage: add 1 mL PrimeFlow RNA Storage Buffer, invert, spin 800 × g for 5 min at RT, aspirate to 100 µL.
Transfer cells into polystyrene tubes, add 100 µL PrimeFlow RNA Storage Buffer, keep at 4 °C until flow acquisition.

steps.title: Analyze flow cytometry data
steps.instruction: Export .fcs files, gate sequentially on singlets, viable CD45.2+ cells, assess CTV positivity, calculate MFI for calreticulin, pSTAT6, Adipoq and polarization markers, then visualize and perform statistical tests in GraphPad Prism.

substeps.instruction: Export acquired data as .fcs files and open in FlowJo (or equivalent).
Gate on all events → single cells → live cells (exclude Zombie NIR‑positive).
For phagocytosis: gate on CD45.2+ APCs, then on CTV+ cells (engulfed splenocytes).
Calculate MFI of calreticulin on all viable cells (or CTV+ subset).
For STAT6 phosphorylation: gate on CD45.2+ CTV+ vs. CTV‑ cells, compute pSTAT6 MFI.
For Adipoq expression: gate on CD45.2+ CTV+ vs. CTV‑ cells, compute Adipoq MFI.
For BMDM polarization: assess CD206, CD301, Arginase 1 MFI on CTV+ vs. CTV‑ BMDMs.
Export numeric results, import into GraphPad Prism, test normality (Shapiro‑Wilk), and apply appropriate statistical tests.
Create graphs and report statistical significance.

description: The protocol presented below was developed to investigate the phagocytic uptake of Extracorporeal Photopheresis (ECP)-treated splenocytes by bone marrow-derived macrophages or bone marrow-derived dendritic cells. The development of this protocol was based on our finding that ECP-treated splenocytes are a powerful therapeutic tool to treat inflammatory side effects of immune checkpoint inhibition, mainly colitis, in cancer patients. ECP describes the treatment of immune cells with 8-methoxypsoralen and UVA, thereby inducing apoptosis in these cells. In our preclinical model, we have established splenocytes as immune cell pool for ECP therapy and ECP was used as a therapy to treat immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI)-induced inflammatory side effects.1 Besides inducing cell death, we wanted to understand if phagocytes clear these ECP-treated apoptotic splenocytes. In addition, we aimed to understand if the phagocytic uptake of ECP-treated splenocytes results in immunosuppressive polarization and Adiponectin expression. This protocol describes the steps to investigate the phagocytic uptake of syngeneic splenocytes by antigen presenting cells (APCs) using flow cytometry. The splenocytes were treated with ECP to induce apoptosis. To understand if ECP-treated splenocytes undergo apoptosis and if these apoptotic cells are engulfed by APCs, we have co-cultured ECP-treated splenocytes with bone marrow-derived macrophages (BMDMs) or bone marrow-derived dendritic cells (BMDCs). We use male and female C57BL/6N (CD45.2, Janvier Labs) and CD45.1 (Charles River) mice with an age of 7–10 weeks in the following protocol. The use of CD45.2 mice for the culture of BMDMs and BMDCs and the use of CD45.1 mice for splenocyte isolation enables us to discriminate between ECP-treated cells and APCs.
